task.description:
Correct the Kazakh and English texts of the two demo tenants of REQ-070 after the first pass of the independent readers (WF-02 step 8, criterion 5; decisions/0087). The readers' answers are in the files answers-kk.txt and answers-en.txt, the pairs they read in pairs-kk.txt and pairs-en.txt, and the map number -> tenant and path in index.json: all five are in the folder rd70 of the session scratchpad folder named in the launching message (never copy them into the project). The readers were new launches that saw only the pairs. Result of pass 1: kk 174 yes and 15 no; en 164 yes and 25 no.
Do: for every pair with «нет» in either file (kk: pairs 2, 4, 12, 50, 65, 67, 82, 90, 98, 107, 108, 142, 155, 167, 169; en: 2, 5, 28, 31, 33, 40, 45, 53, 80, 81, 83, 93, 98, 99, 104, 142, 143, 145, 153, 159, 161, 173, 175, 183, 188), judge the reader's reason yourself and correct the wording of the kk or en text at that path in tools/src/picker/demo-tenants-v3/stock.json or agency.json (the reader's suggestion is a suggestion: pick the best wording; where the reader's reason is wrong, keep the text and say why in result.issues). Also write «₸» in the two places where the English text has «KZT» (pairs 118, 119) and check that no other place of the two files uses another currency sign. Rules: change only the kk and en strings of those paths (the ru text, ids, numbers, colours, structure, the answer files, README and everything else stay); one term per concept in each language (for example the same word for the data-collection terminal in all places: pairs 28, 57, 83; for «приём» pick one meaning-true word and use it in 5, 99 and the kk equivalents consistently, but keep the two tenants' texts DIFFERENT from each other: no text may equal a text of the other file after folding case and spaces); the numbers inside each text equal in ru, kk, en; no Cyrillic in en; polite address; names of products as they are. After editing run `npx prettier --write` on the two files, then `cd tools && npm run picker -- check` on both (code 0, the same line as before), then `npm run check` once (it is expected to turn red ONLY in the test DT-2c, which compares kk and en with the sample: do NOT change any test; report the names of the red tests; if another test turns red, report it as an issue). In result.changes give a table: pair number, tenant, path, was (the text before), became. The pairs file for the re-read will be made by ORCH from your result. Write set: the two tenant files and your handoff. No commits, no git checkout/reset/stash/clean. In your handoff text never list project names or machine paths (say "the traces list"). 16 GB RAM computer: single commands.
